## Incident Overview
test_validate_findings_schema_pass_no_tmpfile_remains FAILED in a local full-suite run (798 passed, 1 failed) on origin/main HEAD 0e388e9e81, but the SAME test PASSED in CI on PR #531's Script Tests and in the isolated #3' worktree run (825 passed). The local run was in a worktree with heavy accumulated /tmp state from a long session. The test asserts no tmpfile remains after validate_findings_schema; likely detecting unrelated leftover /tmp files (isolation) rather than a real leak — but verify validate_findings_schema isn't leaking a tmpfile on the pass path. Priority low (CI-green). code_version: 0e388e9e81
data.title: test_runner_smoke.py::test_validate_findings_schema_pass_no_tmpfile_remains: passes in CI -> fails in a /tmp-polluted local worktree (suspected isolation/flake)
